verdict.rationale: HubSpot's developer docs explicitly reference an llms.txt index ('Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/llms.txt') and confirm markdown-appendable pages ('Append .md to any documentation page URL'), and many citations in this pack are themselves .md doc URLs that were successfully used as sources, showing the agent-readable docs pattern works in practice. However, independent probes hitting the most obvious top-level paths (https://developers.hubspot.com/llms.txt and /docs.md) returned 404, so there's no clean confirmation the exact claimed llms.txt path resolves, leaving some doubt about full reliability of the mechanism. Missing for 10: a probe confirming the actual /docs/llms.txt endpoint returns 200, and no independent hands-on report of an agent successfully consuming it end-to-end.
